term: necessary implication of a worldview or duty-content
definition: A worldview entails content p when p holds at every world satisfying all of the worldview's explicitly held contents; content q follows from content p when q holds at every world where p holds. Necessity is relative to one fixed specified semantic profile, not an unrestricted claim about metaphysical necessity.
note: Formalizes the user's reference to necessary implications without assuming logical omniscience or a modal bridge. Alternative metaphysical or epistemic consequence relations require their own interpretations.
